decisions.rationale: Lead Metagross+Incineroar: Incineroar's Intimidate + FakeOut disrupts Maushold Follow Me and weakens Arcanine-Hisui/Annihilape. Metagross can Mega Evolve for Tough Claws Meteor Mash, targeting Floette or Maushold. Mamoswine backline provides Ice Shard priority and Earthquake spread KOs. Meowscarada cleans late with Protean coverage. This mode handles the Follow Me + Light of Ruin core while preserving speed control options.
decisions.notebook: Opponent prioritizes aggressive Light of Ruin over Protect when pressured. Maushold Follow Me is the linchpin for enabling Floette-Mega and Arcanine-Hisui; disrupting it is essential. Floette-Mega Protect success rate drops after consecutive use. Metagross +1 Attack via Meteor Mash is a proven win condition. Mamoswine Earthquake excels at spread KOs. Preserve Meowscarada for late-game cleanup. Watch for Scarf Dragapult U-turn cycles and Defiant Annihilape switches on Intimidate.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega Floette. Lead Floette+Maushold: T1 Follow Me + LoR/Protect punishes Incin/Meow and softens Gross. Back Arcanine+Basc complete vs sun/Mamo/Tork with Head Smash/Wave Crash and sash LR; avoids pure physical Gross+Mamo trap on Mega alone.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: opp sun (Torkoal Charcoal Drought) + Mega Metagross TC with Incin FakeOut/Intim/Sitrus Impish Parting/Blitz/Protect, Meow LO Protean Timid FlowerTrick/DarkPulse/GrassKnot/Protect, Mamo Jolly sash ThickFat IceShard/EQ/RockSlide/Protect, Rotom Scarf. Gross Jolly Mega Mash/IcePunch/BulletPunch/Protect. We: Mega Floette Fairy pressure + Maushold FG redirect, RH LO H-Arcanine, Basc sash Adapt (Wave Crash covers Tork/Mamo, Last Respects). Priority targets Tork/Gross/Meow. Opp g1 brought Gross/Incin/Meow/Mamo (no sun/scarf). LR recoil heavy under Fairy Aura. Plan: avoid Mega Floette vs Gross+Mamo priority; prefer Basc/Arcanine and force Tork/Rotom reveals. G2 lead Flo+Maus; back Arc+Basc.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out (+3 priority) flinches Maushold before its Follow Me (+2), preventing redirection. Meteor Mash hits Floette super-effectively (81-193% range, possible OHKO). Metagross resists both foes' attacks (0.5x to Light of Ruin, 0.5x to Population Bomb). Holding Mega Evolution preserves Tough Claws boost for later turns when needed. This is the standard aggressive T1 line that pressures the primary threat while neutralizing the Follow Me linchpin.

decisions.rationale: Mega Metagross targets Floette-Mega to bait Follow Me redirect onto Maushold, while Incineroar directly targets Maushold. If Maushold uses Follow Me (+2 priority), both attacks hit Maushold maximizing KO chance. If Maushold Protects, Metagross still damages Floette-Mega. If Maushold attacks, both foes take damage. Disrupting Maushold's Follow Me is essential to neutralizing Floette-Mega's offensive potential. Incineroar's Sitrus Berry and high Defense should survive -1 Atk Population Bomb.

decisions.rationale: Metagross (178 Spe) outspeeds both foes; Meteor Mash KOs 33% Floette-Mega (2x SE, Tough Claws). Mamoswine Rock Slide chips Basculegion (neutral, 90% acc) and hits Floette if Protect fails. Basculegion's Focus Sash means it survives one hit from full, but Rock Slide + follow-up Meteor Mash secures KO. Mamoswine's Focus Sash absorbs Basculegion's Wave Crash. Rock Slide preferred over Protect to break sash and pressure both foes simultaneously.

Protect gives 50% chance to survive this turn and preserve my last Pokémon for a potential comeback. Opponent favors aggressive LoR per notebook, making Protect the only line with nonzero win probability.

reflections.summary: Lost due to a flawed team-preview plan: Mega Metagross and Mamoswine lack special bulk and are heavily threatened by Arcanine’s Fire moves and Basculegion’s Ghost/Water coverage, while the frail Life Orb Meowscarada cannot survive the combined physical priority (Aqua Jet, Extreme Speed) and Floette-Mega’s Light of Ruin. The four brought and intended Mega lacked a dedicated Fairy/Water resist or special wall, leaving no sustainable answer once the physical core was removed.
reflections.adjustment: Replace the frail Life Orb Meowscarada with a bulkier Fairy/Water-resistant special wall or Assault Vest user to safely absorb Light of Ruin and priority. Lead with a structure that cycles Intimidate to neuter Arcanine and Basculegion, and avoid relying on a single frail sweeper against this priority-heavy composition.
reflections.notebook: Opponent aggressively favors Light of Ruin over Protect when pressured; Floette-Mega is the designated late-game win condition. Core relies on physical priority (Basculegion Aqua Jet, Arcanine-Hisui Extreme Speed) to clean weakened targets. Basculegion is Ground-immune; requires Rock Slide, Steel moves, or status. Maushold enables priority sweepers via Follow Me/Population Bomb. Dragapult (Scarf) and Annihilape (Defiant) are held back for Intimidate cycling or late cleanup; expect U-turn pivots and Defiant activation on Intimidate switches. Future plan: Prioritize a bulky Fairy/Water resist or special wall to absorb Light of Ruin and priority. Cycle Intimidate to neuter physical priority. Avoid frail Life Orb sweepers against this priority-heavy composition.
